## 2. Applicability


Phase 2 is explicitly authorized for a NEW reference composition only. Public route family: home → models → model detail → inquiry/result → locations.
Admin/ops direction remains conditionally approved and its implementation is protected. Public candidates remain PENDING_USER_APPROVAL.
No cloud execution, production authorization or real franchise is implied. This extends T2804; it does not reopen V402/337 or replace the broader operating protocol.

## 3. Architecture contract

Only public route sources and public-scoped components/styles/media may change. `src/app/layout.tsx` is the reviewed shared-rendering exception: it selects public rendering while preserving the original private rendering. The exact `src/app/api/enterprise/leads/route.ts` and `src/app/api/enterprise/appointments/route.ts` are the two public-effect exceptions: the negative public journey exposed missing Origin rejection, corrected while preserving consent/idempotency and the existing owners. No other API/auth/private route is allowed. `application-chrome.tsx`, its sidebar/drawer, global CSS, design tokens and dependencies are protected by the manifest.
The active design authority stays TS-DESIGN-SYSTEM-V403. Page-specific CSS is scoped; no second global theme runtime is installed. Existing BFF/domain owners keep authorization, validation, idempotency and actual effects. No business values or backend permissions are fabricated by UI selectors.
All before/payload/decoded hashes and private source guards are checked before writing. An exclusive cooperating-writer lock and atomic file replacement are used. Ordinary write failures roll back already written files. This is NOT a crash-atomic directory transaction or sandbox against hostile concurrent filesystem mutation.
Consumer content/media, prices, availability, addresses and business copy require their own authorized source. Generated reference imagery does not establish a product specification or commercial claim. Secrets, browser session data and screenshots of third-party account UI are absent from the payload.

````ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { requestAppointment } from "@/platform/backend/public-client";
import { applicationBaseUrl } from "@/platform/auth/oidc-client";
import { errorResponse, problem } from "@/platform/http/problem";

const schema = z.object({
  leadId: z.string().min(1).max(128),
  modelId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(),
  kind: z.enum(["consultation", "test-drive", "delivery", "service"]),
  startsAt: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true })
}).strict();

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  // Same configured-origin guard as the public lead stage; no effect precedes it.
  try { if (request.headers.get("origin") !== applicationBaseUrl().origin) return problem(403,"Origen no permitido","El turno debe solicitarse desde esta aplicación.","CROSS_ORIGIN_REJECTED"); }
  catch { return problem(403,"Origen no permitido","La reserva no está disponible.","CROSS_ORIGIN_REJECTED"); }
  const key = request.headers.get("idempotency-key");
  if (!key || key.length < 16 || key.length > 128) return problem(400, "Falta idempotencia", "Envíe una clave estable para este intento.", "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED");
  try {
    const input = schema.parse(await request.json());
    const result = await requestAppointment({ leadId: input.leadId, kind: input.kind, startsAt: input.startsAt, ...(input.modelId ? { modelId: input.modelId } : {}) }, key);
    return Response.json(result.value, { status: result.status, headers: { "cache-control": "no-store", ...(result.replayed ? { "idempotency-replayed": "true" } : {}) } });
  } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
}
````

````ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { captureLead } from "@/platform/backend/public-client";
import { applicationBaseUrl } from "@/platform/auth/oidc-client";
import { errorResponse, problem } from "@/platform/http/problem";
const schema = z.object({ modelId: z.string().min(1).max(128).optional(), name: z.string().trim().min(2).max(120), email: z.email().max(254), consentGranted: z.literal(true) }).strict();
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  // AUTHORED narrow correction using the existing configured-origin owner.
  // Reject before parsing the body, idempotency transport or any business effect.
  // Neither the request Host nor forwarding headers supply the trusted origin.
  try { if (request.headers.get("origin") !== applicationBaseUrl().origin) return problem(403,"Origen no permitido","La consulta debe enviarse desde esta aplicación.","CROSS_ORIGIN_REJECTED"); }
  catch { return problem(403,"Origen no permitido","La consulta no está disponible.","CROSS_ORIGIN_REJECTED"); }
  const key = request.headers.get("idempotency-key");
  if (!key || key.length < 16 || key.length > 128) return problem(400, "Falta idempotencia", "Envíe una clave estable para este intento.", "IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED");
  try {
    const input = schema.parse(await request.json());
    const result = await captureLead({ ...(input.modelId ? { modelId: input.modelId } : {}), sourceCode: "public-web", contact: { name: input.name, email: input.email.toLowerCase() }, consentGranted: true }, key);
    return Response.json(result.value, { status: result.status, headers: { "cache-control": "no-store", ...(result.replayed ? { "idempotency-replayed": "true" } : {}) } });
  } catch (error) { return errorResponse(error); }
}
````

````tsx
import {PublicRouteBoundary} from "@/components/public-web/public-shell";
import {ApplicationChrome,ApplicationNavigationProvider} from "@/components/application-chrome";
import { publicMessage as message } from "@/platform/i18n/public-catalog";
import {PrivateLocaleProvider} from "@/platform/i18n/private-provider";
import {PrivateLanguageSwitcher} from "@/components/private-language-switcher";
import {loadPrivateLocale} from "@/platform/i18n/load-private-locale";
import { loadPublicLocale } from "@/platform/i18n/load-public-locale";
import type { Metadata, Route } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { loadBusinessConfig } from "@/platform/config/load";
import { allowed, readSession } from "@/platform/auth/session";
import { enabledNavigation } from "@/platform/config/registry";
import { connection } from "next/server";
import "./globals.css";

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const config = await loadBusinessConfig();
  const locale = await loadPublicLocale();
  return {
    title: { default: config.business.name, template: `%s | ${config.business.name}` },
    description: message(locale.locale, "site.description"),
    robots: { index: false, follow: false }
  };
}

export default async function RootLayout({ children }: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) {
  await connection();
  const config = await loadBusinessConfig();
  const locale = await loadPrivateLocale();
  const publicLocale = await loadPublicLocale();
  const session = await readSession();
  const navigation = enabledNavigation(config, session?.permissions ?? null);
  const documentsVisible = process.env.DOCUMENTS_ENABLED === "true" && session && session.tenantId === process.env.DOCUMENTS_TENANT_ID && session.organizations.includes(process.env.DOCUMENTS_ORGANIZATION_ID ?? "") && ["documents:write", "documents:process", "documents:review"].some(permission => allowed(session, permission));
  const appNavigation = [...navigation.map(item => ({ href: item.href, label: message(locale.locale, "nav." + item.id) })), ...(documentsVisible ? [{ href: "/experience/documents", label: locale.language === "en" ? "Invoices" : "Facturas" }] : [])];
  return (
    <html lang={locale.locale}>
      <body><PrivateLocaleProvider locale={locale}><ApplicationNavigationProvider>
        <a className="skipLink" href="#main">{message(locale.locale, "site.skip")}</a>
        <PublicRouteBoundary brand={config.business.name} supportEmail={config.business.supportEmail} locale={publicLocale.locale} privateLocale={locale.locale} navigation={navigation.map(item=>({href:item.href,label:item.label}))} privateHeader={<ApplicationChrome kind="header" brand={config.business.name} signedIn={Boolean(session)} canPrepareDelivery={Boolean(session && allowed(session,"handover:manage"))} navigation={appNavigation}><header>
          <div className="shell headerRow">
            <Link className="brand" href="/">{config.business.name}</Link>
            <nav aria-label={message(locale.locale, "site.navigation")}>
              {navigation.map((item) => <Link key={item.id} href={item.href as Route}>{message(locale.locale, "nav." + item.id)}</Link>)}
            </nav>{session?<PrivateLanguageSwitcher/>:null}
          </div>
        </header></ApplicationChrome>} privateFooter={<ApplicationChrome kind="footer"><footer><div className="shell">{message(locale.locale, "site.contact")} <a href={`mailto:${config.business.supportEmail}`}>{config.business.supportEmail}</a></div></footer></ApplicationChrome>}>{children}</PublicRouteBoundary>
      </ApplicationNavigationProvider></PrivateLocaleProvider></body>
    </html>
  );
}
````

````tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import type {Metadata} from "next";
import {loadPublicLocale} from "@/platform/i18n/load-public-locale";
import {listLocations,listAppointmentSlots,type AppointmentKind,type AppointmentSlot} from "@/platform/backend/public-client";
import {readPublicIndexing} from "@/platform/seo/public-indexing";
import {AppointmentForm} from "./appointment-form";
import {publicText as t} from "@/components/public-web/messages";
import {PublicIcon,PublicEmpty} from "@/components/public-web/public-ui";
import s from "@/components/public-web/public-web.module.css";
export async function generateMetadata():Promise<Metadata>{
  const locale=await loadPublicLocale();
  const {origin}=readPublicIndexing();
  // Locations is outside the approved indexing allowlist. Keep it noindex;
  // receipt/query references never enter the canonical URL or title.
  return {title:t(locale.locale,"locations"),robots:{index:false,follow:false},...(origin?{alternates:{canonical:new URL("/locations",origin).href}}:{})};
}
export default async function LocationsPage({searchParams}:{searchParams:Promise<{lead_id?:string;model_id?:string}>}){
  const [locale,query]=await Promise.all([loadPublicLocale(),searchParams]);
  const locationResult=await listLocations().then(items=>({items,failed:false}),()=>({items:[],failed:true}));
  let slots:AppointmentSlot[]=[];let slotsFailed=false;
  // No appointment calls until a lead receipt supplies context, as this page
  // cannot request a valid appointment without that existing owner reference.
  if(query.lead_id){
    const from=new Date(Date.now()+60000).toISOString();const to=new Date(Date.now()+30*24*60*60000).toISOString();
    const kinds:AppointmentKind[]=["consultation","test-drive","delivery","service"];
    try{slots=(await Promise.all(kinds.map(kind=>listAppointmentSlots(kind,from,to)))).flat().sort((a,b)=>a.starts_at.localeCompare(b.starts_at));}catch{slotsFailed=true;}
  }
  const retry=new URLSearchParams();if(query.lead_id)retry.set("lead_id",query.lead_id);if(query.model_id)retry.set("model_id",query.model_id);
  return <div className={s.content} lang={locale.locale}><section className={s.pageHeading}><p className={s.eyebrow}>{t(locale.locale,"locations")}</p><h1>{t(locale.locale,"visit")}</h1><p>{t(locale.locale,"visitBody")}</p></section>
    {locationResult.failed?<PublicEmpty title={t(locale.locale,"locationError")} locale={locale.locale} retryHref={`/locations${retry.size?"?"+retry.toString():""}`}/>:locationResult.items.length?<section className={s.locations} aria-label={t(locale.locale,"locations")}>{locationResult.items.map(location=><article className={s.location} key={location.organization_id}><PublicIcon name="pin"/><h2>{location.name}</h2><p>{[location.city,location.region,location.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}</p><div className={s.contactLinks}>{location.contact_phone&&<a href={`tel:${location.contact_phone}`}><PublicIcon name="phone"/>{t(locale.locale,"call")}</a>}{location.contact_email&&<a href={`mailto:${location.contact_email}`}><PublicIcon name="mail"/>{t(locale.locale,"email")}</a>}</div></article>)}</section>:<div className={s.empty} data-public-state="empty"><h2>{t(locale.locale,"noLocations")}</h2><p>{t(locale.locale,"noLocationsBody")}</p><Link href="/models" className={s.secondary}>{t(locale.locale,"explore")}</Link></div>}
    {query.lead_id?<section className={s.booking}><h2>{t(locale.locale,"book")}</h2><p>{t(locale.locale,"bookBody")}</p>{slotsFailed?<div className={s.uncertain} role="status" data-public-state="error"><p>{t(locale.locale,"slotsError")}</p><a className={s.secondary} href={`/locations?${retry.toString()}`}>{t(locale.locale,"retry")}</a></div>:<AppointmentForm leadId={query.lead_id} slots={slots} locale={locale} {...(query.model_id?{modelId:query.model_id}:{})}/>}</section>:<section className={s.startInquiry}><h2>{t(locale.locale,"startInquiry")}</h2><p>{t(locale.locale,"startInquiryBody")}</p><Link href="/models" className={s.secondary}>{t(locale.locale,"explore")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></Link></section>}
  </div>;
}
````

````tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { loadPublishedCatalog } from "@/platform/catalog/load";
import { publicModelMetadata } from "@/platform/seo/public-indexing";
import { loadPublicLocale } from "@/platform/i18n/load-public-locale";
import { modelClass, modelDescription, publicSpecifications, startingPrice, variantPrice } from "@/components/public-web/catalog-presentation";
import { PublicIcon } from "@/components/public-web/public-ui";
import { PublicLeadForm } from "@/components/public-web/public-lead-form";
import { PublicMedia } from "@/components/public-web/public-media";
import { publicText as t } from "@/components/public-web/messages";
import s from "@/components/public-web/public-web.module.css";

export const dynamic="force-dynamic";
async function selected(code:string){const catalog=await loadPublishedCatalog();const model=catalog?.models.find(item=>item.code===code);if(!catalog||!model)notFound();return{catalog,model};}
export async function generateMetadata({params}:{params:Promise<{code:string}>}){const{model}=await selected((await params).code);return publicModelMetadata(model.code,model.displayName,model.canonical_url);}
export default async function ModelPage({params}:{params:Promise<{code:string}>}){
  const [{catalog,model},locale]=await Promise.all([selected((await params).code),loadPublicLocale()]);
  const variants=catalog.variants.filter(item=>item.model_id===model.id);
  const price=startingPrice(catalog,model.id,locale.locale);
  const description=modelDescription(model.specification);
  const specifications=publicSpecifications(model.specification,locale.locale);
  return <div className={s.content} lang={locale.locale}>
    <Link href="/models" className={s.backLink}><PublicIcon name="arrow"/>{t(locale.locale,"backModels")}</Link>
    <section className={s.detailHero}><div className={s.detailIntro}><p className={s.eyebrow}>{modelClass(model.vehicleClass,locale.locale)}</p><h1>{model.displayName}</h1>{description&&<p>{description}</p>}{price&&<div className={s.price}><p>{price.prefix} {price.amount}</p><span>{price.tax}</span></div>}<div className={s.actions}><a href="#consulta" className={s.primary}>{t(locale.locale,"inquire")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></a><a href="#versions" className={s.secondary}>{t(locale.locale,"variants")}</a></div></div>
      <figure className={s.detailImage}><PublicMedia src={`/api/public/catalog/media/${model.media.sha256}`} alt={model.displayName} width={model.media.width} height={model.media.height} locale={locale.locale} priority/></figure>
    </section>
    <section className={s.detailsSection} id="versions"><h2>{t(locale.locale,"variants")}</h2><div className={s.variants}>{variants.map(variant=>{const value=variantPrice(variant,catalog.currency,locale.locale);const battery=modelDescription(variant.battery_specification);return<article className={s.variant} key={variant.id}><h3>{variant.display_name}</h3><div className={s.price}><p>{value.amount}</p><span>{value.tax}</span></div>{battery&&<p>{battery}</p>}</article>;})}</div></section>
    {specifications.length>0&&<section className={s.detailsSection}><h2>{t(locale.locale,"specifications")}</h2><dl className={s.specifications}>{specifications.map(item=><div key={item.label}><dt>{item.label}</dt><dd>{item.value}</dd></div>)}</dl></section>}
    <section className={s.inquiry} id="consulta"><div className={s.inquiryIntro}><p className={s.eyebrow}>{model.displayName}</p><h2>{t(locale.locale,"talk")}</h2><p>{t(locale.locale,"inquiryBody")}</p></div><PublicLeadForm modelId={model.id} locale={locale.locale}/></section>
  </div>;
}
````

````tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { headers } from "next/headers";
import { loadBusinessConfig } from "@/platform/config/load";
import { loadPublicLocale } from "@/platform/i18n/load-public-locale";
import { publicPageMetadata, websiteJsonLd } from "@/platform/seo/public-indexing";
import { PublicIcon, PublicEmpty, PublicVisit } from "@/components/public-web/public-ui";
import { PublicProductCard, readPublicModels } from "@/components/public-web/public-catalogue";
import { publicText as t } from "@/components/public-web/messages";
import s from "@/components/public-web/public-web.module.css";

export function generateMetadata(){return publicPageMetadata("/");}
export default async function HomePage(){
  const [config,locale,result]=await Promise.all([loadBusinessConfig(),loadPublicLocale(),readPublicModels()]);
  const structuredData=websiteJsonLd(config.business.name,locale.locale);
  const nonce=(await headers()).get("x-nonce")??undefined;
  return <div lang={locale.locale}>
    {structuredData&&<script type="application/ld+json" nonce={nonce} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html:structuredData}}/>}
    <section className={s.hero}>
      <img className={s.heroImage} src="/public-web/urban-hero.jpg" alt={t(locale.locale,"heroAlt")} width="1672" height="941" fetchPriority="high"/>
      <div className={s.heroContent}><p className={s.eyebrow}>{t(locale.locale,"eyebrow")}</p><h1>{t(locale.locale,"homeTitle")}</h1><p>{t(locale.locale,"homeBody")}</p><div className={s.actions}><Link href="/models" className={s.primary}>{t(locale.locale,"explore")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></Link><Link href="/locations" className={s.secondary}>{t(locale.locale,"findUs")}</Link></div></div>
      <span className={s.heroCaption}>{t(locale.locale,"conceptual")}</span>
    </section>
    <div className={s.content}><section className={s.collection}><div className={s.sectionTitle}><div><p className={s.eyebrow}>{t(locale.locale,"collection")}</p><h2>{t(locale.locale,"catalogueTitle")}</h2></div><Link href="/models" className={s.textLink}>{t(locale.locale,"explore")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></Link></div>
      {result.failed?<PublicEmpty title={t(locale.locale,"catalogueError")} locale={locale.locale} retryHref="/">{t(locale.locale,"catalogueErrorBody")}</PublicEmpty>:result.models.length?<div className={s.productGrid}>{result.models.slice(0,2).map(model=><PublicProductCard model={model} catalog={result.catalog} locale={locale.locale} key={model.id}/>)}</div>:<PublicEmpty title={t(locale.locale,"noModels")} locale={locale.locale}>{t(locale.locale,"noModelsBody")}</PublicEmpty>}
    </section><PublicVisit locale={locale.locale}/></div>
  </div>;
}
````

````ts
import type { PublishedCatalog } from "@/platform/catalog/schema";
import { minorAmountPresentation } from "@/platform/i18n/money";
import { publicText as t, type PublicTextKey } from "./messages";

export function modelClass(value:string,locale:string){const known:Record<string,PublicTextKey>={bicycle:"bicycle",motorcycle:"motorcycle",scooter:"scooter",utility:"utility",car:"car",other:"other"};return t(locale,known[value]??"other");}
export function modelDescription(specification:Record<string,unknown>){return typeof specification.description==="string"?specification.description:null;}
export function publicSpecifications(specification:Record<string,unknown>,locale:string){
  // Present only labeled, existing source fields. Never infer units or decode
  // unknown raw technical structures into unreviewed commercial claims.
  const fields:Record<string,PublicTextKey>={range:"range",weight:"weight",motor:"motor",battery:"battery",maximum_speed:"speed",frame:"frame",wheels:"wheels",brakes:"brakes",warranty:"warranty"};
  return Object.entries(fields).flatMap(([key,label])=>typeof specification[key]==="string"?[{label:t(locale,label),value:specification[key] as string}]:[]);
}
export function variantPrice(variant:PublishedCatalog["variants"][number],currency:string,locale:string){
  const amount=BigInt(variant.amount_minor_units);
  const display=minorAmountPresentation(amount<=BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)?Number(amount):NaN,currency,locale);
  return {amount:display.amountValid?display.amountLabel:t(locale,"priceUnavailable"),valid:display.amountValid,tax:t(locale,variant.tax_mode==="inclusive"?"included":variant.tax_mode==="exclusive"?"excluded":"notApplicable")};
}
export function startingPrice(catalog:PublishedCatalog,modelId:string,locale:string){
  const variants=catalog.variants.filter(item=>item.model_id===modelId);
  // Mixed tax modes are not comparable; send the reader to all explicit versions.
  if(!variants.length||new Set(variants.map(item=>item.tax_mode)).size!==1)return null;
  const lowest=variants.reduce((a,b)=>BigInt(a.amount_minor_units)<=BigInt(b.amount_minor_units)?a:b);
  const price=variantPrice(lowest,catalog.currency,locale);
  return price.valid?{...price,prefix:variants.length>1?t(locale,"priceFrom"):""}:null;
}
````

````tsx
import Link from "next/link";
import { loadPublicLocale } from "@/platform/i18n/load-public-locale";
import { loadPublishedCatalog } from "@/platform/catalog/load";
import { listModels, type PublicModel } from "@/platform/backend/public-client";
import type { PublishedCatalog } from "@/platform/catalog/schema";
import { publicText as t } from "./messages";
import { modelClass, modelDescription, startingPrice } from "./catalog-presentation";
import { PublicIcon, PublicEmpty, PublicVisit } from "./public-ui";
import { PublicLeadForm } from "./public-lead-form";
import { PublicMedia } from "./public-media";
import s from "./public-web.module.css";

export async function readPublicModels():Promise<{catalog:PublishedCatalog|null;models:PublicModel[];failed:boolean}>{
  try{const catalog=await loadPublishedCatalog();return{catalog,models:catalog?.models??(process.env.CATALOG_RELEASE_ENABLED==="true"?[]:await listModels()),failed:false};}
  catch{return{catalog:null,models:[],failed:true};}
}
export function PublicProductCard({model,catalog,locale}:{model:PublicModel;catalog:PublishedCatalog|null;locale:string}){
  const published=catalog?.models.find(item=>item.id===model.id);
  const price=catalog?startingPrice(catalog,model.id,locale):null;
  const description=modelDescription(model.specification);
  return <article className={s.productCard}>
    <div className={s.productMedia}>{published?<PublicMedia src={`/api/public/catalog/media/${published.media.sha256}`} alt={model.displayName} width={published.media.width} height={published.media.height} locale={locale}/>:<span className={s.noMedia}>{t(locale,"noMedia")}</span>}</div>
    <div className={s.productInfo}><div><p className={s.eyebrow}>{modelClass(model.vehicleClass,locale)}</p><h2>{model.displayName}</h2>{description&&<p className={s.cardDescription}>{description}</p>}</div>
      {price&&<div className={s.price}><p>{price.prefix} {price.amount}</p><span>{price.tax}</span></div>}
      {published?<Link className={s.cardAction} aria-label={`${t(locale,"detail")}: ${model.displayName}`} href={`/models/${model.code}`}>{t(locale,"detail")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></Link>:<details className={s.inquiryDisclosure}><summary>{t(locale,"inquire")}</summary><PublicLeadForm modelId={model.id} locale={locale}/></details>}
    </div>
  </article>;
}
export async function PublicCatalogue(){const [result,locale]=await Promise.all([readPublicModels(),loadPublicLocale()]);
  return <div className={s.content} lang={locale.locale}><section className={s.pageHeading}><p className={s.eyebrow}>{t(locale.locale,"collection")}</p><h1>{t(locale.locale,"catalogueTitle")}</h1><p>{t(locale.locale,"catalogueBody")}</p></section>
    {result.failed?<PublicEmpty title={t(locale.locale,"catalogueError")} locale={locale.locale} retryHref="/models">{t(locale.locale,"catalogueErrorBody")}</PublicEmpty>:result.models.length?<><p className={s.count}>{result.models.length} {t(locale.locale,result.models.length===1?"modelsOne":"modelsMany")}</p><section className={s.productGrid} aria-label={t(locale.locale,"models")}>{result.models.map(model=><PublicProductCard key={model.id} model={model} catalog={result.catalog} locale={locale.locale}/>)}</section></>:<PublicEmpty title={t(locale.locale,"noModels")} locale={locale.locale}>{t(locale.locale,"noModelsBody")}</PublicEmpty>}
    <PublicVisit locale={locale.locale}/></div>;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { publicText as t } from "./messages";
import { PublicIcon } from "./public-ui";
import s from "./public-web.module.css";

type Submission = { modelId:string; name:string; email:string; consentGranted:true };
type SubmissionState = "idle"|"pending"|"error"|"uncertain"|"success";
// AUTHORED presentation adapter over the existing BFF. No new commercial rule.
// An uncertain write retains both key and exact payload. No automatic retry.
export function PublicLeadForm({modelId,locale}:{modelId:string;locale:string}) {
  const formId=useId();
  const request=useRef<{key:string;payload:Submission}|null>(null);
  const inFlight=useRef(false);
  const [state,setState]=useState<SubmissionState>("idle");
  const [leadId,setLeadId]=useState("");
  const [error,setError]=useState<"invalid"|"failed"|"unavailable">("failed");
  async function submit(event:FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if(inFlight.current||state==="success")return;
    const values=new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    if(state!=="uncertain") {
      request.current={key:crypto.randomUUID(),payload:{modelId,name:String(values.get("name")??""),email:String(values.get("email")??""),consentGranted:true}};
      if(values.get("consent")!=="on"){setError("invalid");setState("error");request.current=null;return;}
    }
    const attempt=request.current;
    if(!attempt)return;
    inFlight.current=true;setState("pending");
    try {
      const response=await fetch("/api/enterprise/leads",{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json","idempotency-key":attempt.key},body:JSON.stringify(attempt.payload),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});
      if(!response.ok){
        // A gateway failure or conflict may follow a committed operation.
        if(response.status>=500||[408,409,429].includes(response.status)){setState("uncertain");return;}
        request.current=null;setError(response.status===400||response.status===422?"invalid":response.status===401||response.status===403?"unavailable":"failed");setState("error");return;
      }
      const body:unknown=await response.json();
      const receipt=body&&typeof body==="object"&&"lead_id"in body?body.lead_id:null;
      if(typeof receipt!=="string"||!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$/u.test(receipt)){setState("uncertain");return;}
      setLeadId(receipt);setState("success");
    }catch{setState("uncertain");}finally{inFlight.current=false;}
  }
  return <form className={s.leadForm} onSubmit={submit} aria-describedby={`${formId}-result`} data-public-state={state} aria-busy={state==="pending"}>
    {state!=="success"&&<fieldset disabled={state==="pending"||state==="uncertain"}>
      <label htmlFor={`${formId}-name`}>{t(locale,"name")}<input id={`${formId}-name`} name="name" required minLength={2} maxLength={120} autoComplete="name" /></label>
      <label htmlFor={`${formId}-email`}>{t(locale,"emailLabel")}<input id={`${formId}-email`} name="email" type="email" required maxLength={254} autoComplete="email" /></label>
      <label className={s.consent} htmlFor={`${formId}-consent`}><input id={`${formId}-consent`} name="consent" type="checkbox" required/><span>{t(locale,"consent")}</span></label>
    </fieldset>}
    <div id={`${formId}-result`} role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" className={state==="success"?s.success:state==="error"?s.error:state==="uncertain"?s.uncertain:s.result}>
      {state==="pending"&&<p>{t(locale,"sending")}</p>}
      {state==="error"&&<p>{t(locale,error)}</p>}
      {state==="uncertain"&&<><p><strong>{t(locale,"uncertain")}</strong></p><p>{t(locale,"uncertainBody")}</p></>}
      {state==="success"&&<><PublicIcon name="check"/><h3>{t(locale,"received")}</h3><p>{t(locale,"receivedBody")}</p></>}
    </div>
    {state==="success"?<a className={s.primary} href={`/locations?lead_id=${encodeURIComponent(leadId)}&model_id=${encodeURIComponent(modelId)}`}>{t(locale,"next")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></a>:<button type="submit" disabled={state==="pending"} className={s.primary}>{t(locale,state==="pending"?"sending":state==="uncertain"?"check":"send")}<PublicIcon name="arrow"/></button>}
  </form>;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import {useEffect,useState} from "react";
import {publicText as t} from "./messages";
import s from "./public-web.module.css";
// Missing published media never falls back to another product or to a concept.
export function PublicMedia({src,alt,width,height,locale,priority=false}:{src:string;alt:string;width:number;height:number;locale:string;priority?:boolean}){
  const [failed,setFailed]=useState(false);
  useEffect(()=>{setFailed(false);},[src]);
  if(failed)return<span className={s.noMedia} role="img" aria-label={`${alt}: ${t(locale,"noMedia")}`} data-media-state="error">{t(locale,"noMedia")}</span>;
  return<img src={src} alt={alt} width={width} height={height} loading={priority?"eager":"lazy"} fetchPriority={priority?"high":"auto"} onError={()=>setFailed(true)}/>;
}
````

````tsx
"use client";
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { PublicIcon } from "./public-ui";
import { publicText as t } from "./messages";
import s from "./public-web.module.css";

const PublicLocaleContext=createContext("es");
export const usePublicWebLocale=()=>useContext(PublicLocaleContext);

// Exact allowlist. Private /admin, /customer, /help, /guide NEVER become public
// through a negative app test. Existing private chrome is supplied unchanged.
export function isPublicWebPath(path: string) {
  return ["/", "/models", "/locations", "/connected"].includes(path) || /^\/models\/[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/u.test(path);
}
export function PublicRouteBoundary({ children, privateHeader, privateFooter, brand, supportEmail, locale, privateLocale, navigation }: { children:ReactNode; privateHeader:ReactNode; privateFooter:ReactNode; brand:string; supportEmail:string; locale:string; privateLocale:string; navigation: {href:string; label:string}[] }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  if (!isPublicWebPath(pathname)) return <>{privateHeader}<main id="main" className="shell" lang={privateLocale}>{children}</main>{privateFooter}</>;
  return <PublicShell brand={brand} supportEmail={supportEmail} locale={locale} navigation={navigation}>{children}</PublicShell>;
}
function PublicShell({ children, brand, supportEmail, locale, navigation }: {children:ReactNode;brand:string;supportEmail:string;locale:string;navigation:{href:string;label:string}[]}) {
  const pathname=usePathname();
  const [open,setOpen]=useState(false);
  const toggle=useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const nav=useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const links=navigation.filter(item=>["/models","/locations","/customer"].includes(item.href));
  useEffect(()=>{setOpen(false);},[pathname]);
  useEffect(()=>{if(!open)return; const listener=(event:KeyboardEvent)=>{if(event.key==="Escape"){setOpen(false);toggle.current?.focus();}}; document.addEventListener("keydown",listener);return()=>document.removeEventListener("keydown",listener);},[open]);
  useEffect(()=>{const query=window.matchMedia("(min-width: 761px)");const reset=()=>{if(query.matches)setOpen(false);};query.addEventListener("change",reset);return()=>query.removeEventListener("change",reset);},[]);
  return <PublicLocaleContext.Provider value={locale}><div className={s.root} lang={locale} data-public-web="V403-0.1.0">
    <header className={s.header}>
      <div className={s.headerInner}>
        <Link href="/" className={s.brand}>{brand}</Link>
        <button ref={toggle} type="button" className={s.menuButton} aria-label={t(locale,open?"closeMenu":"menu")} aria-controls="public-navigation" aria-expanded={open} onClick={()=>setOpen(value=>!value)}><PublicIcon name={open?"close":"menu"}/></button>
        <nav ref={nav} id="public-navigation" className={`${s.navigation} ${open?s.navigationOpen:""}`} aria-label={t(locale,"navigation")}>
          {links.map(item=><a key={item.href} href={item.href} className={item.href==="/customer"?s.accountLink:undefined} aria-current={pathname===item.href||(item.href==="/models"&&pathname.startsWith("/models/"))?"page":undefined} onClick={()=>setOpen(false)}>{item.href==="/locations"&&<PublicIcon name="pin"/>}{item.href==="/models"&&<PublicIcon name="model"/>}{t(locale,item.href==="/models"?"models":item.href==="/locations"?"locations":"account")}</a>)}
        </nav>
      </div>
    </header>
    <main id="main" className={s.main}>{children}</main>
    <footer className={s.footer}><Link href="/" className={s.brand}>{brand}</Link><nav aria-label={t(locale,"contact")}><a href={`mailto:${supportEmail}`}><PublicIcon name="mail"/>{t(locale,"contact")}</a><Link href="/locations">{t(locale,"locations")}</Link></nav></footer>
  </div></PublicLocaleContext.Provider>;
}
````

````tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { publicText as t } from "./messages";
import s from "./public-web.module.css";

// AUTHORED small geometric pictograms. No upstream icon assets or brand marks.
export function PublicIcon({ name }: { name: "arrow" | "pin" | "menu" | "close" | "check" | "mail" | "phone" | "model" }) {
  const paths = { arrow:"M5 12h14 M13 6l6 6-6 6", pin:"M12 21s7-7 7-12a7 7 0 0 0-14 0c0 5 7 12 7 12Z M12 6a3 3 0 1 0 0 6 3 3 0 0 0 0-6", menu:"M4 7h16 M4 12h16 M4 17h16",close:"M6 6l12 12 M18 6 6 18", check:"m5 12 4 4 10-10",mail:"M3 5h18v14H3z m0 0 9 8 9-8",phone:"M7 3H4c-1 8 9 18 17 17v-4l-5-2-2 2-6-6 2-2-3-5Z",model:"M4 6h16v12H4z M4 10h16 M10 10v8" };
  return <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d={paths[name]} /></svg>;
}
export function PublicEmpty({ title, children, locale, retryHref }: { title: string; children?: ReactNode; locale: string; retryHref?: string }) {
  return <div className={s.empty} data-public-state={retryHref ? "error" : "empty"}><span className={s.emptyIcon}><PublicIcon name="model" /></span><h2>{title}</h2>{children && <p>{children}</p>}<a className={s.secondary} href={retryHref ?? "/locations"}>{t(locale,retryHref ? "retry" : "findUs")}<PublicIcon name="arrow" /></a></div>;
}
export function PublicVisit({ locale }: { locale: string }) { return <section className={s.visit}><div><p className={s.eyebrow}>{t(locale,"locations")}</p><h2>{t(locale,"closer")}</h2><p>{t(locale,"closerBody")}</p></div><Link href="/locations" className={s.secondary}><PublicIcon name="pin" />{t(locale,"findUs")}</Link></section>; }
````

````css
  .hero h1 { font-size:clamp(3.35rem,13vw,4.8rem);max-width:none;margin:.85rem 0 1rem; }
  .heroContent>p:not(.eyebrow) { font-size:.92rem;max-width:22rem; }
  .heroImage { position:relative;inset:auto;order:2;width:100%;height:90vw;max-height:350px;object-fit:cover;object-position:right center; }
  .hero::after { top:auto;bottom:0;height:min(350px,90vw);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--surface),transparent 24%); }
  .hero .actions { margin-top:1.5rem;gap:.6rem; }
  .hero .primary,.hero .secondary { font-size:.8rem;padding:.75rem 1rem; }
  .heroCaption { font-size:.6rem;bottom:1rem;right:5%; }
  .collection { padding-top:3.5rem; }.sectionTitle {align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem;}
  .sectionTitle h2 {font-size:2.2rem;}.sectionTitle .textLink {font-size:.8rem;}
  .pageHeading {padding:3rem 0 2rem;}.pageHeading h1 {font-size:3.2rem;}.pageHeading>p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:.95rem;}
  .productGrid {grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.25rem;}.productGrid>.productCard:only-child {display:block;}.productGrid>.productCard:only-child .productInfo {padding:1.5rem;}
  .productInfo {padding:1.5rem;gap:1.1rem;}.productInfo h2 {font-size:2rem;}.productMedia,.productGrid>.productCard:only-child .productMedia {aspect-ratio:1.3;}
  .visit {margin-top:3.5rem;padding:3rem 0;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:1.75rem;}.visit h2 {font-size:2.15rem;}
  .root .footer {padding:1.5rem 5%;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:1rem;}.footer nav{gap:1.5rem;}.footer .brand{max-width:100%;}
  .empty {padding:3.5rem .3rem;}.empty h2{font-size:1.4rem;}
  .detailHero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:0 0 2.5rem;gap:1.5rem;}.detailIntro{padding:.75rem 0;}.detailIntro h1{font-size:3.5rem;}.detailIntro .price{margin-top:1.3rem;}.detailIntro .actions{max-width:none;margin-top:1.5rem;grid-template-columns:1fr;}.detailImage{aspect-ratio:1.1;}.detailIntro>p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:.95rem;}
  .detailsSection{padding:2.5rem 0 0;}.detailsSection h2{font-size:1.8rem;}.specifications{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.variants{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .inquiry{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2rem;padding:3rem 0;margin-top:3rem;}.inquiry h2{font-size:2.7rem;}.leadForm{max-width:none;}
  .location{padding:1.5rem;}.location h2{font-size:1.6rem;}.booking{padding:2rem 0 4rem;}.startInquiry{padding:1.5rem;}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .root *, .root *::before,.root *::after { transition:none!important;animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important; } }
````

````python
"""AUTHORED public-only V403 composition glue; no install, network or deployment.

Adaptation of the library-owned V403 UI overlay algorithm, not external code.
All validation completes before file mutation; ordinary failures roll back.
Per-file replacement is atomic. A power loss is NOT a multi-file transaction.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import tempfile

SCHEMA = "public-web-overlay/v1"
EXACT_PUBLIC = frozenset({
    "src/app/page.tsx", "src/app/layout.tsx",
    "src/app/models/page.tsx", "src/app/models/[code]/page.tsx",
    "src/app/locations/page.tsx", "src/app/connected/page.tsx",
    # Public inquiry/appointment effect boundaries only: Origin enforcement
    # discovered by negative journey tests. No other API/auth/private route.
    "src/app/api/enterprise/leads/route.ts",
    "src/app/api/enterprise/appointments/route.ts",
})
PUBLIC_ROUTES = ("src/app/models/", "src/app/models/[code]/", "src/app/locations/", "src/app/connected/")
PUBLIC_PREFIXES = ("src/components/public-web/", "src/styles/public-web/",
                   "src/platform/public-web/", "public/public-web/", "docs/public-web/")
STATE_FILES = frozenset({"loading.tsx", "error.tsx", "not-found.tsx"})
HEX64 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")
RESERVED = re.compile(r"(?:CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9]|LPT[1-9])(?:\..*)?\Z", re.I)


def digest(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def validate_relative(relative: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(relative, str) or not relative or any(c in relative for c in "\\:\x00"):
        raise ValueError("Unsafe relative path")
    path = PurePosixPath(relative)
    if path.is_absolute() or path.as_posix() != relative:
        raise ValueError("Path must be canonical relative POSIX: " + relative)
    for part in path.parts:
        if part in (".", "..") or part.endswith((" ", ".")) or RESERVED.fullmatch(part):
            raise ValueError("Unsafe path component: " + relative)
        if any(ord(c) < 32 or c in '<>"|?*' for c in part):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported path component: " + relative)
    return relative


def is_public_target(relative: str) -> bool:
    validate_relative(relative)
    if relative in EXACT_PUBLIC or relative.startswith(PUBLIC_PREFIXES):
        return True
    return any(relative == parent + filename for parent in PUBLIC_ROUTES for filename in STATE_FILES)


def no_links(path: Path) -> None:
    """Reject links including the supplied root and its existing ancestors."""
    for entry in (path, *path.parents):
        if entry.is_symlink() or (hasattr(entry, "is_junction") and entry.is_junction()):
            raise ValueError("Link or junction forbidden: " + str(entry))


def safe(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    validate_relative(relative)
    target = root.joinpath(*PurePosixPath(relative).parts)
    no_links(target)
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()):
        raise ValueError("Path escapes root: " + relative)
    return target


def _hash(value, nullable=False):
    if nullable and value is None:
        return
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not HEX64.fullmatch(value):
        raise ValueError("Invalid SHA-256")


def read_manifest(bundle: Path) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    no_links(bundle)
    data = safe(bundle, "overlay-manifest.json").read_bytes()
    manifest = json.loads(data)
    if manifest.get("schema_version") != SCHEMA or manifest.get("pack_id") != "TS-PUBLIC-WEB-EXPERIENCE-V403":
        raise ValueError("Unsupported public overlay manifest")
    if manifest.get("phase2_authorized") is not True or manifest.get("production_authorized") is not False:
        raise ValueError("Implementation authority/scope mismatch")
    if manifest.get("active_design_system") != "TS-DESIGN-SYSTEM-V403":
        raise ValueError("A second design-system authority is forbidden")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("files"), list) or not manifest["files"]:
        raise ValueError("Empty or invalid source manifest")
    if not isinstance(manifest.get("protected_files"), list) or not manifest["protected_files"]:
        raise ValueError("Private preservation baseline missing")
    _hash(manifest.get("base_package_sha256"))
    names, sources = set(), set()
    for row in manifest["files"]:
        name, source = row["target"], row["bundle_path"]
        if not is_public_target(name):
            raise ValueError("Target is not public-allowlisted: " + name)
        if not validate_relative(source).startswith("files/"):
            raise ValueError("Source must be inside bundle/files")
        if name.casefold() in names or source.casefold() in sources:
            raise ValueError("Duplicate or case-colliding manifest path")
        names.add(name.casefold()); sources.add(source.casefold())
        _hash(row["before_sha256"], True); _hash(row["after_sha256"]); _hash(row["payload_sha256"])
        if row["encoding"] not in ("utf8", "base64"):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported payload encoding")
    protected = set()
    for row in manifest["protected_files"]:
        name = validate_relative(row["path"])
        if name.casefold() in names or name.casefold() in protected:
            raise ValueError("Protection overlap/duplicate")
        _hash(row["sha256"]); protected.add(name.casefold())
    mandatory = {"src/components/application-chrome.tsx", "src/app/globals.css", "package.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml"}
    if not mandatory.issubset(protected):
        raise ValueError("Required private/design/dependency guards missing")
    return manifest, digest(data)


def check_protected(target: Path, manifest: dict) -> None:
    for row in manifest["protected_files"]:
        path = safe(target, row["path"])
        if not path.is_file() or digest(path.read_bytes()) != row["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Protected source drift: " + row["path"])


def atomic_write(destination: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    no_links(destination)
    fd, name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".public-overlay-", dir=destination.parent)
    tmp = Path(name)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp, destination)
    finally:
        tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def apply(bundle: Path, target: Path, verify=False) -> dict:
    # Check lexical roots before resolve, so a symlink root is never normalized away.
    no_links(bundle); no_links(target)
    bundle, target = bundle.resolve(), target.resolve()
    if not target.is_dir() or target == bundle or (target / "AGENT_SYSTEM_START.md").exists():
        raise ValueError("Requires an existing independent reference target, never library/bundle")
    # Historical V402 is immutable. Callers must create a NEW composition first.
    if any(part in ("Elite Franchise Reference V402", "signed-release-v402-r330") for part in target.parts):
        raise ValueError("Refusing historical V402 destination")
    manifest, manifest_sha = read_manifest(bundle)
    if digest(safe(target, "package.json").read_bytes()) != manifest["base_package_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Incompatible package.json")
    check_protected(target, manifest)
    pending = []
    for row in manifest["files"]:
        payload = safe(bundle, row["bundle_path"]).read_bytes()
        if digest(payload) != row["payload_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Bundle payload hash mismatch: " + row["target"])
        data = base64.b64decode(payload.strip(), validate=True) if row["encoding"] == "base64" else payload
        if row["encoding"] == "utf8":
            data.decode("utf8")
        if digest(data) != row["after_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Decoded source hash mismatch: " + row["target"])
        destination = safe(target, row["target"])
        if destination.exists() and not destination.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Target is not a regular file: " + row["target"])
        before = destination.read_bytes() if destination.exists() else None
        observed = digest(before) if before is not None else None
        if observed not in (row["before_sha256"], row["after_sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("Target revision conflict: " + row["target"])
        if verify and observed != row["after_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Overlay missing: " + row["target"])
        pending.append((destination, before, data, row))
    written, made_dirs = [], []
    if not verify:
        lock = safe(target, ".public-web-overlay.lock")
        fd = os.open(lock, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
        try:
            os.write(fd, str(os.getpid()).encode())
            check_protected(target, manifest)
            # Recheck ALL targets under the lock before the first mutation.
            for destination, before, _, row in pending:
                no_links(destination)
                if (destination.read_bytes() if destination.exists() else None) != before:
                    raise ValueError("Concurrent change before apply: " + row["target"])
            for destination, before, data, row in pending:
                if before == data:
                    continue
                no_links(destination)
                if (destination.read_bytes() if destination.exists() else None) != before:
                    raise ValueError("Concurrent change during apply: " + row["target"])
                absent = []
                parent = destination.parent
                while not parent.exists():
                    absent.append(parent); parent = parent.parent
                for directory in reversed(absent):
                    directory.mkdir(); made_dirs.append(directory)
                written.append((destination, before))
                atomic_write(destination, data)
            check_protected(target, manifest)
            for destination, _, data, row in pending:
                no_links(destination)
                if destination.read_bytes() != data:
                    raise ValueError("Postcondition mismatch: " + row["target"])
        except Exception:
            for destination, before in reversed(written):
                no_links(destination)
                if before is None:
                    destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                elif not destination.exists() or destination.read_bytes() != before:
                    atomic_write(destination, before)
            for directory in reversed(made_dirs):
                directory.rmdir()
            raise
        finally:
            os.close(fd); lock.unlink()
    return {"schema_version": "public-web-overlay-receipt/v1", "revision": manifest["revision"],
            "status": "PASS", "claim": "HASH_LOCKED_PUBLIC_COMPOSITION_ONLY",
            "phase2_authorized": True, "production_authorized": False,
            "visual_approval": "PENDING_USER_APPROVAL", "cloud_execution": "NOT_RUN",
            "target": str(target), "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha,
            "files_verified": len(pending), "files_changed": len(written),
            "protected_files_verified": len(manifest["protected_files"]),
            "files": [{"path": row["target"], "before_sha256": row["before_sha256"], "sha256": row["after_sha256"]}
                      for _, _, _, row in pending],
            "limits": ["Per-file atomic writes and ordinary-exception rollback; no power-loss transaction",
                       "Exclusive cooperating-writer lock; not a hostile concurrent-writer sandbox",
                       "Source preservation is separate from browser regression and human approval"]}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--bundle", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    parser.add_argument("--target", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--report", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    no_links(args.report)
    # Reports are new evidence; never silently replace a previous receipt/source.
    if args.report.exists():
        raise ValueError("Report must be absent: " + str(args.report))
    report_resolved, target_resolved = args.report.resolve(), args.target.resolve()
    if report_resolved.is_relative_to(target_resolved):
        rel = report_resolved.relative_to(target_resolved).as_posix()
        if not rel.startswith("qualification/"):
            raise ValueError("In-target report must be under qualification/")
    result = apply(args.bundle, args.target, args.verify)
    args.report.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with args.report.open("x", encoding="utf8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, indent=2); stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ("status", "files_verified", "files_changed", "protected_files_verified")}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

````text
# Public V403 bounded qualification

This AUTHORED harness uses the composition's already pinned Microsoft Playwright,
Node and JOSE dependencies. It acquires no new dependencies and makes no provider
calls. Runtime data is synthetic, including the model, price, city, contact and
appointment. The media argument must be an authorized PNG within the existing
catalog pixel bounds; passing it does not claim that the media admission or Go
normalizer was executed.

Run after building both the previous UI and the new public composition:

```text
python qualification/run_public_qualification.py --target reference --baseline-source ../ui/workspace --evidence evidence/qualification --media <authorized-bounded-PNG> --phase both --node <node> --openssl <openssl>
```

Paths are interpreted relative to the caller. The harness copies the previous
standalone runtime to an absent `public-web/baseline-runtime`, then runs it and
the new standalone build sequentially with the same loopback ports (4321 HTTP,
4322 HTTPS, 4323 synthetic backend), browser, locale, data and viewport. It does
not patch the previous source or previous standalone build. Private screenshots
are generated as comparison references, **not visual approvals**, then compared
with zero permitted pixel differences. The private drawer also retains a draft
and restores focus. Permission-denied views are labeled by the tested identity;
they do not establish business operation for missing grants.

`--toolchain-source <previous-composition>` may reuse an intact, pinned local
Playwright/JOSE installation read-only when the new copy has not preserved pnpm
links. This does not run the previous application: `--target` still selects the
new standalone artifact. The receipt identifies both paths. The baseline copier
preserves Windows junctions instead of flattening packages. Their dependency
targets are local caches, so this is not proof of cloud or portable installation.
`--baseline-runtime <new-direct-child-of-public-web>` supports a fresh baseline
after a failed setup while retaining the failure directory. Omitting `--media`
uses the packaged `prepare_fixtures` helper, which verifies and decodes the exact
fixture PNG; it never replaces mismatched bytes.

`--phase candidate` reuses existing private comparison files after a bounded
fix. `--grep` limits candidate tests only. A failing run remains a failed receipt;
the final run must name its exact source revision and preceding failure/fix.
Use separate evidence directories when preserving complete run histories.

The bounded `coverage matrix` test runs three synthetic cases (zero models, one
long-name model, three models/classes) at 768px. Run it twice with
`--grep "coverage matrix" --locale es-AR` and `--locale en-US`, each with a separate
evidence directory. The runner selects the trusted business locale before process
startup because the existing configuration owner caches it; the test deliberately
sends the opposite Accept-Language to confirm headers do not override business
configuration. These are two checks with six fixture combinations. Their six
screenshots are diagnostics and do not join the twelve public visual candidates.

Public screenshots go to `evidence/candidates` with SHA-256 and
`PENDING_USER_APPROVAL`. No screenshot update confers acceptance. Browser reports
and per-test synthetic backend receipts record the actual tests executed. The
uncertain-write test covers response loss and an explicit same-key retry within
the **same mounted form**. Refresh/new-session recovery is not implemented or
claimed. The synthetic in-memory fixture's idempotence does not certify the
durable Go/PostgreSQL owner.

Computed contrast covers actual rendered text over solid ancestor backgrounds.
A separate hero probe renders text transparently without moving elements and
measures the minimum contrast under actual text-line rectangles from the rendered
background PNG using the already pinned Playwright PNG decoder. Its diagnostic
images are **not** visual candidates. These measurements cover only the exact
tested image, CSS and two viewports. Other image/gradient cases remain excluded.
Viewports
320/390/1440 are not a physical phone test. Screen reader, real browser zoom,
field performance, cloud, production and human acceptance remain NOT_RUN or
PENDING_USER_APPROVAL until separately demonstrated. The new public and previous
admin approvals remain independent.

TLS/session signing keys are generated only in a temporary run directory and
removed at exit. The harness disables traces/HAR and uses no real user profiles,
cookies, identities or business data. Persistent evidence contains synthetic
data only. Do not point it at a real product or live backend.
````

````text
let mode='normal',leadMode='normal',writes=[],attempts=[],records=new Map();

 if(u.pathname==='/v1/public/elite-mobility/locations')return send(res,200,{items:[{organization_id:'store',code:'centro',name:'Sucursal Centro',city:'Buenos Aires',region:'Buenos Aires',country:'AR'}]});
 if(u.pathname.endsWith('/appointment-slots'))return send(res,200,{items:u.searchParams.get('kind')==='consultation'?[{id:'slot-fixture',organization_id:'store',kind:'consultation',starts_at:'2030-09-18T14:00:00Z',ends_at:'2030-09-18T14:30:00Z',capacity:1,booked:0,state:'open',version:1}]:[]});
````

````text
import {toolchain,evidence,base} from '../paths.mjs';

 const key=createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(process.env.UI_SESSION_KEY_PATH,'utf8')).digest();
 const token=await new EncryptJWT({subject:'operator',tenantId:'tenant',organizations:['store'],permissions,accessToken:'fixture-access-token'}).setProtectedHeader({alg:'dir',enc:'A256GCM',typ:'JWT'}).setIssuedAt().setExpirationTime('10m').encrypt(key);
 await context.clearCookies();await context.addCookies([{name:'__Host-elite_session',value:token,url:base+'/',secure:true,httpOnly:true,sameSite:'Lax'}]);
}
const routes=['/experience','/franchise','/supply','/factory','/warranty','/network','/admin','/customer'];
for(const path of routes)test('private regression '+path+' desktop and mobile identical',async({page,context})=>{
 await login(context);const response=await page.goto(path);expect(response.status()).toBeLessThan(500);await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
 expect(await page.locator('body').innerText()).not.toContain('Application error:');
 await expect(page.locator('[data-public-web],.publicWeb')).toHaveCount(0);
 const title=await page.locator('h1').first().innerText();expect(title.trim().length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
 for(const width of [1440,390]){
  await page.setViewportSize({width,height:width===390?844:1000});await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready);
  const name='private-'+path.slice(1)+'-'+width+'.png';
  await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(name,{fullPage:true,animations:'disabled',maxDiffPixels:0});
  if(process.env.UI_PHASE!=='baseline'){mkdirSync(resolve(evidence,'admin-after'),{recursive:true});await page.screenshot({path:resolve(evidence,'admin-after',name),fullPage:true,animations:'disabled'});}
 }
});
test('private regression drawer behavior keeps a draft and restores focus',async({page,context})=>{
 await login(context);await page.goto('/franchise');const summary=page.locator('.contactWork>summary').first();await summary.click();
 await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Cotización',exact:true}).click();await page.getByLabel('Producto',{exact:true}).selectOption('variant-v403');
 const input=page.getByLabel('Producto',{exact:true}).locator('xpath=ancestor::form').locator('input[type="datetime-local"]');await input.fill('2030-01-01T10:00');
 await page.setViewportSize({width:390,height:844});const opener=page.getByRole('button',{name:'Abrir menú',exact:true});await opener.click();
 const menu=page.getByRole('dialog',{name:'Menú',exact:true});await expect(menu).toBeVisible();await expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:'Cerrar menú',exact:true})).toBeFocused();
 for(let i=0;i<18;i++){await page.keyboard.press('Tab');expect(await menu.evaluate(n=>n.contains(document.activeElement))).toBe(true);}
 await page.keyboard.press('Escape');await expect(menu).toBeHidden();await expect(opener).toBeFocused();await expect(input).toHaveValue('2030-01-01T10:00');
 await opener.click();await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot('private-franchise-drawer-390.png',{fullPage:true,maxDiffPixels:0});
 await menu.getByRole('button',{name:'Agenda',exact:true}).click();await opener.click();await menu.getByRole('button',{name:'Gestión diaria',exact:true}).click();
 await expect(page.getByLabel('Producto',{exact:true})).toHaveValue('variant-v403');await expect(input).toHaveValue('2030-01-01T10:00');
 await page.setViewportSize({width:1440,height:1000});expect(await page.locator('dialog[open]').count()).toBe(0);
});
````

````text
// AUTHORED coverage extension; executes on the same product build, no new design.
import {toolchain,evidence,backend} from '../paths.mjs';
import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import {resolve} from 'node:path';import {writeFileSync,mkdirSync} from 'node:fs';

 const observations=[];const diagnostic=resolve(evidence,'coverage-diagnostics');mkdirSync(diagnostic,{recursive:true});
 await page.setViewportSize({width:768,height:1024});
 // Headers must not silently replace the configured public business language.
 await page.setExtraHTTPHeaders({'accept-language':en?'es-AR':'en-US'});
 for(const mode of ['empty','longtext','multiple']){
  await request.post(backend+'/fixture/reset');await request.post(backend+'/fixture/mode?catalog='+mode);await page.goto('/models');await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-public-web]')).toHaveAttribute('lang',locale);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:en?'Electric models':'Modelos eléctricos',exact:true})).toBeVisible();
  const cards=page.locator('[data-public-web] main article');await expect(cards).toHaveCount(mode==='empty'?0:mode==='longtext'?1:3);
  if(mode==='empty')await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:en?'New models are on their way.':'Estamos preparando nuevos modelos.',exact:true})).toBeVisible();
  if(mode==='longtext'){
   await expect(page.getByRole('heading',{name:longName,exact:true})).toBeVisible();
   const heading=await page.getByRole('heading',{name:longName,exact:true}).evaluate(el=>({scroll:el.scrollWidth,client:el.clientWidth,height:el.getBoundingClientRect().height,text:el.textContent,clamp:getComputedStyle(el).webkitLineClamp}));
   expect(heading.scroll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(heading.client+1);expect(heading.text).toBe(longName);expect(heading.clamp).toBe('none');
   observations.push({mode,heading});
  }
  if(mode==='multiple')for(const [name,label]of [['Urban',en?'Bicycle':'Bicicleta'],['Touring',en?'Motorcycle':'Motocicleta'],['Cargo',en?'Utility vehicle':'Utilitario']]){
   const card=cards.filter({has:page.getByRole('heading',{name,exact:true})});await expect(card.getByText(label,{exact:true})).toBeVisible();await expect(card.getByRole('link',{name:(en?'Explore model: ':'Conocer modelo: ')+name,exact:true})).toBeVisible();
  }
  expect(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1)).toBe(true);await page.screenshot({path:resolve(diagnostic,locale+'-'+mode+'-tablet.png'),fullPage:true,animations:'disabled'});
  observations.push({mode,locale,viewport:{width:768,height:1024},cards:await cards.count(),no_horizontal_overflow:true});
  if(mode!=='empty'){
   await cards.first().getByRole('link').click();await expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:en?'Send inquiry':'Enviar consulta',exact:true})).toBeVisible();await expect(page.getByLabel(en?'Name':'Nombre',{exact:true})).toBeVisible();await expect(page.getByRole('checkbox',{name:en?'I agree to be contacted about this model.':'Acepto ser contactado sobre este modelo.',exact:true})).not.toBeChecked();
   expect(await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth+1)).toBe(true);
   if(mode==='longtext')await expect(page.getByText('ReferenciaExtensaSinEspacios'.repeat(7),{exact:true})).toBeVisible();
  }
  const stats=await(await request.get(backend+'/fixture/stats')).json();expect(stats.writes).toHaveLength(0);
 }
 writeFileSync(resolve(evidence,'coverage-matrix.json'),JSON.stringify({status:'PASS',build:'EXISTING_R4_NO_PRODUCT_DELTA',method:'CHROMIUM_768_VIEWPORT_PUBLISHED_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES_WITH_TRUSTED_CONFIG_LOCALE',locale,observations,screenshots:'DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_NEW_APPROVED_BASELINES',limits:['No physical tablet, screen reader or user acceptance','Only existing configured translations plus synthetic content, not every language or real catalog']},null,2));
````

````text
test('public computed solid-surface text contrast includes forms and semantic result states',async({page,request})=>{
 const measurements=[];
 async function inspect(label){const result=await page.evaluate(()=>{
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=1;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
  function rgba(css){ctx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);ctx.fillStyle=css;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);return [...ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data];}
  const blend=(a,b)=>a.slice(0,3).map((v,i)=>v*(a[3]/255)+b[i]*(1-a[3]/255));
  const lum=c=>c.map(v=>{const n=v/255;return n<=.04045?n/12.92:((n+.055)/1.055)**2.4;}).reduce((n,v,i)=>n+v*[.2126,.7152,.0722][i],0);
  const rows=[],excluded=[];
  for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('[data-public-web] *')){
   const style=getComputedStyle(el),rect=el.getBoundingClientRect();
   if(!rect.width||!rect.height||style.visibility==='hidden'||el.closest('[aria-hidden="true"],fieldset:disabled')||el.matches(':disabled')||!Array.from(el.childNodes).some(n=>n.nodeType===3&&n.textContent.trim()))continue;
   const chain=[];for(let p=el;p;p=p.parentElement)chain.push(p);
   if(chain.some(p=>getComputedStyle(p).backgroundImage!=='none'||['::before','::after'].some(pseudo=>getComputedStyle(p,pseudo).content!=='none'&&getComputedStyle(p,pseudo).backgroundImage!=='none'))){excluded.push({text:el.textContent.trim().slice(0,50),reason:'IMAGE_OR_GRADIENT_REQUIRES_PIXEL_OR_MANUAL_REVIEW'});continue;}
   let bg=[255,255,255];for(const p of chain.reverse())bg=blend(rgba(getComputedStyle(p).backgroundColor),bg);
   const fg=blend(rgba(style.color),bg),l1=lum(fg),l2=lum(bg),ratio=(Math.max(l1,l2)+.05)/(Math.min(l1,l2)+.05),large=parseFloat(style.fontSize)>=24||(parseFloat(style.fontSize)>=18.66&&Number(style.fontWeight)>=700);
   rows.push({text:el.textContent.trim().slice(0,70),ratio,required:large?3:4.5,foreground:style.color,background:bg});
  }return{rows,excluded};
 });measurements.push({label,...result});expect(result.rows.length).toBeGreaterThan(8);expect(result.rows.filter(r=>r.ratio+.01<r.required)).toEqual([]);}
 for(const path of ['/','/models','/models/urban','/locations']){await page.goto(path);await inspect(path);}
 await page.goto('/models/urban');await fill(page);await mode(request,'lead=reject');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Enviar consulta',exact:true}).click();await expect(page.locator('[data-public-state="error"]')).toBeVisible();await inspect('rejection');
 await mode(request,'lead=normal');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Enviar consulta',exact:true}).click();await expect(page.locator('[data-public-state="success"]')).toBeVisible();await inspect('success');
 writeFileSync(resolve(evidence,'public-computed-contrast.json'),JSON.stringify({method:'CHROMIUM_COMPUTED_SOLID_SURFACE_SRGB_TEXT',limits:['Excludes image or gradient-backed text; not a complete contrast audit','No screen reader/physical-device/user acceptance'],measurements},null,2));
});

    const style=getComputedStyle(el);ctx.clearRect(0,0,1,1);ctx.fillStyle=style.color;ctx.fillRect(0,0,1,1);const foreground=[...ctx.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data].slice(0,3);
    const rectangles=[];for(const node of el.childNodes)if(node.nodeType===3&&node.textContent.trim()){const range=document.createRange();range.selectNodeContents(node);for(const rect of range.getClientRects())rectangles.push({x:rect.x,y:rect.y,width:rect.width,height:rect.height});}
    const large=parseFloat(style.fontSize)>=24||(parseFloat(style.fontSize)>=18.66&&Number(style.fontWeight)>=700);
    el.setAttribute('data-contrast-probe',String(index));el.style.setProperty('-webkit-text-fill-color','transparent','important');el.style.setProperty('color','transparent','important');el.style.setProperty('text-shadow','none','important');
    return{text:el.textContent.trim(),foreground,rectangles,required:large?3:4.5};
   });
  });
  const screenshot=await page.screenshot({animations:'disabled'});writeFileSync(resolve(evidence,'hero-contrast-diagnostics','backdrop-'+width+'.png'),screenshot);const png=PNG.sync.read(screenshot);
  const lum=c=>c.map(v=>{const n=v/255;return n<=.04045?n/12.92:((n+.055)/1.055)**2.4;}).reduce((n,v,i)=>n+v*[.2126,.7152,.0722][i],0);
  const rows=elements.map(el=>{let min=Infinity,pixels=0;const fg=lum(el.foreground);for(const r of el.rectangles)for(let y=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(r.y));y<Math.min(png.height,Math.floor(r.y+r.height));y++)for(let x=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(r.x));x<Math.min(png.width,Math.floor(r.x+r.width));x++){const offset=(y*png.width+x)*4,bg=lum([...png.data.subarray(offset,offset+3)]),ratio=(Math.max(fg,bg)+.05)/(Math.min(fg,bg)+.05);min=Math.min(min,ratio);pixels++;}return{...el,min_ratio:Number.isFinite(min)?min:null,sampled_pixels:pixels};});
  measurements.push({width,rows});writeFileSync(resolve(evidence,'public-hero-contrast-progress.json'),JSON.stringify({method:'RENDERED_HERO_BACKDROP_TEXT_RECTANGLES',measurements},null,2));expect(rows.filter(r=>r.sampled_pixels===0)).toEqual([]);expect(rows.filter(r=>r.min_ratio+.01<r.required)).toEqual([]);
 }
 writeFileSync(resolve(evidence,'public-hero-contrast.json'),JSON.stringify({method:'CHROMIUM_TEXT_TRANSPARENT_PROBE_PLUS_PINNED_PLAYWRIGHT_PNG_DECODER_MIN_BACKGROUND_CONTRAST_UNDER_TEXT_RANGE_RECTANGLES',diagnostics:'Modified local test render only; NOT visual candidates',limits:['Conservative minimum across text line rectangles, not anti-aliased glyph pixels','Only tested two viewports and exact candidate image/CSS','No screen-reader/physical-device/user acceptance'],measurements},null,2));
});
````

````python
"""AUTHORED exact fixture decoding for the public-web qualification bundle.

No product/source mutation, network, secret handling or dependency install.
The standard Markdown materializer carries binary fixture bytes as base64.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

TARGET = "fixtures/urban-concept-catalog.png"
PAYLOAD = TARGET + ".b64"
HEX = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{64}\Z")


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def no_links(path: Path) -> None:
    for item in (path, *path.parents):
        if item.is_symlink() or (hasattr(item, "is_junction") and item.is_junction()):
            raise ValueError("Fixture path cannot contain links: " + str(item))


def prepare(root: Path) -> Path:
    root = Path(root)
    no_links(root)
    manifest_file = root / "fixture-manifest.json"
    no_links(manifest_file)
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_file.read_bytes())
    if manifest.get("schema_version") != "public-qualification-fixtures/v1" or len(manifest.get("files", [])) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported fixture manifest")
    row = manifest["files"][0]
    if row.get("target") != TARGET or row.get("payload") != PAYLOAD:
        raise ValueError("Only the declared public catalog fixture may be decoded")
    for key in ("payload_sha256", "sha256"):
        if not isinstance(row.get(key), str) or not HEX.fullmatch(row[key]):
            raise ValueError("Invalid fixture SHA")
    payload, destination = root / PAYLOAD, root / TARGET
    no_links(payload); no_links(destination)
    transport = payload.read_bytes()
    if sha(transport) != row["payload_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Fixture base64 transport differs")
    data = base64.b64decode(transport.strip(), validate=True)
    if sha(data) != row["sha256"] or len(data) != row.get("bytes"):
        raise ValueError("Decoded fixture bytes differ")
    if destination.exists():
        if not destination.is_file() or destination.read_bytes() != data:
            raise ValueError("Existing fixture differs; never overwritten")
    else:
        # Exclusive creation is intentional. A second writer must never replace
        # a fixture; ordinary failures remove only this new incomplete output.
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        created = False
        try:
            with destination.open("xb") as stream:
                created = True
                stream.write(data)
        except Exception:
            if created:
                destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            raise
    return destination


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(prepare(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
````

````text
# Public web V403 extension notices

No third-party source, logo, font, image, icon library, or dependency is added by this extension.
AUTHORED integration is licensed LicenseRef-Workspace-Owner; the consuming project must have the owner's authorization.
Existing React, Next, TypeScript and qualification dependencies retain the exact base package/lock and original notices.
These notes supplement, and never replace, the composition's dependency notices.
Public website observations are method references. No ownership or runtime admission is asserted for those brands.
Reference media are project-owned generated imagery, not photographs or evidence of a real franchise/product.
````

## 6. Configuration surface

No secret variables or new runtime dependency are introduced. Existing backend/base URL/fixture controls stay in their established owners. The applier takes `--target`, a new `--report` path, and optional read-only `--verify`. Its default bundle directory is the script directory. The manifest is versioned input, never generated dynamically from an arbitrary consumer to bypass conflicts.

## 7. Dependency bill

The base package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml are hash protected. React, Next, TypeScript, Playwright and axe use the inherited exact pins/notices; no dependency update or fresh external code admission occurs here. Python standard library is the entire composer runtime. Read PROVENANCE.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md alongside the original composition notices.

## 8. Apply order

1. Materialize the existing complete V403 extension into a new reference; apply its original UI 0.3.0/cloud transport layers as selected by the existing plan.
2. Materialize this pack to an absent temporary bundle directory with the standard Markdown materializer, or select it as a disjoint bundle pack in the composition plan.
3. Run `python public_web_overlay/apply_public_overlay.py --target <new-reference> --report <new-evidence-path>`.
4. Repeat with `--verify` and a different new report. A conflict is a compatibility decision, never permission to overwrite. Restore the new reference from the unchanged base if a process/power interruption prevents normal rollback.
5. Build with the inherited lock, then run only the affected public/browser and private-preservation qualifications.

## 9. Verification

`pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`; `pnpm exec next build --webpack`; `python public_web_overlay/qualification/run_public_qualification.py --target <new-reference> --baseline-source <unchanged-v403-ui-workspace> --evidence <new-evidence-directory> --phase both`.
The default catalog fixture is self-contained: its exact PNG bytes are transported as base64 with a manifest and decoded by `qualification/prepare_fixtures.py` only when absent. Existing mismatched fixtures fail rather than being replaced. `--media` remains an explicit override for an independently reviewed fixture. The catalog fixture is distinct from the UI hero and is not deployed to the product.
The harness exercises real local Next UI/BFF against declared fixtures. Source-hash preservation, browser regression, screenshot capture, automated comparison, human visual approval, assistive technology and physical-device checks are distinct claims.
Expected evidence: overlay receipt with before/after hashes, portable materialization receipt, candidate image hashes, route journeys and original-private rendering comparisons. NOT_RUN applies to every method not executed; capture alone is not approved baseline. No performance claim follows from screenshots.

## 10. Reconstruction evidence

This generated pack declares RECONSTRUCTIBLE until a receipt demonstrates standard materialization and the exact composed result. The revision's evidence lives with the public-web implementation report. A browser/public candidate PASS cannot upgrade its visual approval or authorize production.
The library V402 source/ZIP/checkpoint337 is immutable. This pack is an additive extension with its own exact revision and hashes.
